items.meaning: 撑住，坚持一下（安慰／鼓励）
items.quote: Just hang in there. Hang in there.

items.meaning: 这可不是闹着玩的／事情很严重
items.quote: Hit-and-run? It's no joke.

items.meaning: 由某人决定；此处也带“后果看你怎么做”的施压意味
items.quote: - Y... yeah, yeah, maybe. - That's up to you, man.

items.meaning: 聪明点，作出明智选择（可带警告）
items.quote: Yeah, that's right... play it smart.

items.meaning: 碰巧／有没有可能（缓和询问）
items.quote: Is there, by any chance, a Betsy Kettleman here?

items.meaning: 直视某人的眼睛
items.quote: See, I'm not sure if this is a situation where I should or should not look you in the eye.

items.meaning: 我不确定是否……；委婉表达不确定
items.quote: See, I'm not sure if this is a situation where I should or should not look you in the eye.

items.meaning: 根据已有信息作出有依据的推测
items.quote: I'm gonna make an educated guess what happened here.

items.meaning: 越界，做了不该做的事
items.quote: Now, at this juncture, I'm deducing that they said or did something that... Crossed a line,

items.meaning: 让某人认清分寸／教训其别太放肆（强势）
items.quote: and you, with some justification... You put them in their place.

items.meaning: 说到底／最关键的是……（原句有停顿）

items.meaning: 直接动用最极端的手段（比喻，力度强）

items.meaning: 看见某人／某物；常用 never lay eyes on… 表示从未见过

items.meaning: 假设……／前提是……
items.quote: Assuming, you know, that they're still breathing.

items.meaning: 放某人走／解除与某人的牵连；此处是放人

items.meaning: 实施骗局，行骗
items.quote: But I was running a scam.

items.meaning: 让更多人知道我，打出名气
items.quote: This is a good case for me... A lot of publicity. I'll get my name out, and...

items.meaning: 结果某人反而成了笑柄／吃亏的人
items.quote: So, joke's on me. Ha ha!

items.meaning: 事情就是这么回事，仅此而已（限定问题的性质）

items.meaning: 背景或表现为人所知、可以判断的人／事；此处强调身份可核实
items.quote: I'm a known quantity... I am!

items.meaning: 行动的先锋／最前线（比喻，较郑重）
items.quote: I'm the tip of the spear, and releasing me would be the smart move.

items.meaning: 承担全部责任（原文额外用 complete 强调）
items.quote: I take full and complete responsibility,

items.chunk: You really see sb. doing sth.?
items.meaning: 你真觉得某人会做……？（常带怀疑，不是实际看见）

items.selection_status: User accepted as useful common sentence pattern

items.meaning: 怂恿／指使某人做某事（常用于不当行为）
items.quote: They don't deserve to die. I put them up to it.

items.meaning: 某人最疼爱的人；原文临时用了复数 apples，不照搬为标准形式
items.quote: What... for herself? No. No. For them... for these two, her boys, her apples of her eye.

items.meaning: 那是某人的责任／后果由某人承担（不是物理位置）
items.quote: No, that's on them.

items.meaning: 在我看来……（原文省略了 The）
items.quote: Way I see it, that's because you're tough, but you're fair.

items.chunk: make the punishment fit the crime
items.meaning: 让惩罚与过错相称；法律／道德讨论
items.quote: Wait. See, I'm advising... That you make the punishment fit the crime.

items.meaning: 朝错误的方向发展；此处指谈判越谈越偏
items.quote: I think we're heading in the wrong direction.

items.meaning: 我没时间一直等（不耐烦；标准表达 I haven't got all day）
items.quote: All right, lay 'em out! I ain't got all day!

items.meaning: 省省口舌吧／别白费力气说了（可显得冷淡）
items.quote: - You... you... you... aah! Aah! - Save your breath.

items.chunk: talk sb. down from sth. to sth.
items.meaning: 通过劝说把结果从严重程度降到较轻程度；此处夸张地比较死刑与缓刑
items.quote: Hey, I just talked you down from a death sentence... - Oh, my God! Oh, my! - ...to six months' probation.

items.meaning: 你没……吧？（求证，可能带担忧）
items.quote: Jimmy, you didn't drive like this, did you?
items.selection_status: User accepted as useful common sentence pattern

items.meaning: 我可能做过……（保留对过去行为的不确定性）

items.meaning: 我知道这看起来像什么／会让你怎么想（解释可疑情况）
items.quote: Hey, Chuck, listen, I... I know how this looks.

items.chunk: be down to my last dime
items.meaning: 只剩最后一点钱，几乎一文不剩
items.quote: I'm down to my last dime, and, suddenly, I'm paying for broken legs, but...

items.meaning: 糟糕得一团乱／处于严重失序状态（负面评价）
items.quote: - Petty with a prior. - Look, the parents are a train wreck.

items.meaning: 某种东西不够／缺少；此处是停车券不足
items.quote: - You're light on stickers. - Come on.

items.chunk: This is not a me problem. This is a you problem.
items.meaning: 这不是我的问题，是你需要解决的问题（直接、推卸或划清责任）
items.quote: This is not a me problem... This is a you problem.

items.meaning: 各让一步／作出折中，不是路上迎接
items.quote: - Petty with a prior. - Come on. Meet me halfway.

items.meaning: 把某人吓坏／弄得惊慌不安
items.quote: Tuco freaked you out, huh?

items.meaning: 超过某个数字（金额等）
items.quote: Um, north of a million and a half bucks... I think.

items.meaning: 骗取／抢走某人的钱财；此处计划盗取对方的钱
items.quote: - I'm gonna rip them off. - Oh. I like ripping off thieves 'cause they can't go to the cops... they have no recourse.

items.meaning: 我是……，不是……（强调身份、立场或界限）

items.selection_status: User accepted as useful common sentence pattern

items.chunk: I'm not doing that again, not ever.
items.meaning: 我再也不会这样做了，绝不（强调决心）

items.selection_status: User accepted as useful common sentence pattern

items.meaning: 但愿不要发生（插入语，表示不希望某种坏事发生）
items.quote: A-and if you're ever in trouble, God forbid, legal trouble, I will be there, 24-7, as a lawyer.

items.meaning: 你到底有什么目的／打的什么算盘？（怀疑隐藏动机）
items.quote: What's your angle?

items.meaning: 在我看来／就我的立场而言……；不等于据我所知
items.quote: As far as I'm concerned, you're a client.

items.meaning: 参与这套活动／卷入其中；此处指犯罪圈，不等于所有场景都指犯罪
